name: live_two_cells_dlc_lonesome_road
description: Lonesome Road: one peer in the Divide, one on the Courier's Mile. Both start in the collapsed start building (NVDLC04DivideStartBldg). The host leads the party out into the Divide (NVDLC04DivideWorld) and walks to a dead sniper (11700, -462), so the sniper is in the host's loaded grid. The guest goes to Ground Zero on the Courier's Mile (NVDLC04GroundZero, worldspace NVDLC04NukeSilo2) and hits a person there. No door joins the Divide and the Courier's Mile, so `coop cell` puts the guest in the Courier's Mile worldspace and `coop teleport` moves it next to the person (2228, 3809). Outdoors the live layer files each player under its worldspace, so the host must see the guest in NVDLC04NukeSilo2 (67152386) while the guest stands in Ground Zero (67152412). Each peer must own and run the people of its own cell, the host must count the guest's people as the guest's, and neither peer may mirror the other cell's people. After the split the host sets CG03TestValue and the guest asks the host to set DemoVatsCameraGlobal: both values must reach both peers, and the shared hash must agree. A `coop hit NAME 1` line hits that person once for 1 point. The line also names the person, so the simulator loads it (the viewer loads the whole cell). Headless only: the viewer bot has no `coop cell` verb.
